integrity_note: Analytic argument for infinitely many circles using uniform gap domination and a compactly convergent canonical product; no finite numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient reciprocal-summability condition, not a necessary criterion.
Does not bound all exceptional radii from above or classify maxima on the other circles.
The exponent of order and the counting-density logarithm are not claimed optimal.
Possible unindexed historical constructions and no independent audit.
title: Prescribed near-dense exceptional maximum-modulus circles at fixed Taylor gap
